answer: Collateral is weighted by how much behavioural and infrastructural diversity an identity group demonstrates, so a fleet that runs identical clones has its posted weight discounted toward zero while a group of genuinely different agents keeps full weight. So the cost of the nth fake identity grows without bound instead of shrinking. Read it as a meadow weighed by pulse against every ocean nearby: identical ocean groups cancel the pulse and strip the meadow of value, while an ocean with its own history keeps both.
